newsitem.title: FRANCE: France has three firm offers in SFP privatisation.
newsitem.headline: France has three firm offers in SFP privatisation.

text.p: The French govermnment has handed over three firm offers for the SFP film and television production studio to the independent privatisation commission, the finance ministry said on Monday.
The offers will be studied in detail so the ministry can make a proposal on the studio's privatisation by October 10 at the latest, it said in a statement.
The ministry said on Friday that it received a firm offer from Global Studios and other candidates had also emerged to buy Societe Francaise de Production.
It did not identify the other bidders.

Global Studios is headed by French businessman Walter Butler, who has placed a 50 million franc bid for SFP, but wants a 1.2 billion franc state recapitalisation to cover restructuring that includes shedding 667 of a total 1,057 jobs.
Belgian production house LB Convoi is also reported to be interested in SFP.
